review_notes: Reviewed the full article, source record, reel narration, reel data, social copy, and final landscape and square graphics at full size and phone size. The article gives a repeatable channel-by-channel weekly worksheet and differs from the prior overview.

SCORE and SBA sources support tracking acquisition cost by channel, comparing cost with results, and using consistent attribution. Made-up $240 / 6 / $40 figures are clearly labeled fictional; no universal target or business outcome is asserted.
The custom receipt-to-customer-count graphic is topic specific, legible at phone size, consistent with the example, and has no clipping. All required local QA gates passed.

Reel structure was corrected so the hook is included in the parsed narration. The article includes a playable reel embed pointing to the planned canonical MP4 route; deployment remains gated on successful render, hosting, and public verification.
